text.ancestry.fen_born.label: Fen-born
text.ancestry.fey_touched.description: +1 SPI, Fen standing +2. Spell words come in chapter two.
text.ancestry.fey_touched.label: Fey-touched
text.ancestry.hill_folk.description: +1 CON, sight in dark places. Mining comes in a later chapter.
text.ancestry.hill_folk.label: Hill-folk
text.ancestry.road_born.description: +1 DEX, Haggle learned. Crown standing comes in a later chapter.
text.ancestry.road_born.label: Road-born
text.combat.block: Your shield blocks the beast’s strike.
text.combat.hound_fled_east: A wounded fen hound bolts east into Adder Nest.
text.combat.hound_fled_west: A wounded fen hound bolts west into Hound Run.
text.combat.hound_helper_joined: Another fen hound turns to defend its pack.
text.combat.hound_pack_withdrew: No hound remains in this fight.
text.combat.hound_primary_changed: Another fen hound becomes your immediate opponent.
text.combat.npc_died: The beast gives one last shudder and lies still.
text.combat.npc_hit: The beast sinks its teeth into you.
text.combat.npc_miss: The beast snaps at you, but finds only air.
text.combat.player_died: You crumple to the floor. You awaken at the shrine.
text.combat.player_hit: Your blow strikes the beast squarely.
text.combat.player_miss: The beast darts clear of your blow.
text.detail.apple_trees.title: Apple trees
text.detail.bed.free: A plain bed stands upstairs. Maud offers the room downstairs; ordinary rest is still available.
text.detail.bed.paid: You have paid Maud for this bed. You may rest here whenever you return.
text.detail.bed.title: Bed
text.detail.bell.description: The great bell hangs from a timber crossbeam. Its rope is sound, and the clapper waits just clear of the bronze.
text.detail.bell.title: Chapel bell
text.detail.bottom_initials.description: Two worn initials are cut deep into the drowned masonry.
text.detail.carved_fox.description: A fox is carved into the old stone. Its meaning is hidden.
text.detail.cellar_help.description: A notice from Maud asks for help below the inn.
text.detail.cellar_help.title: Help in the cellar
text.detail.cottage_loft.rafters.description: The unpainted rafters bear the marks of an old carpenter's tools.
text.detail.duty_roster.title: Duty roster
text.detail.elspeth_cottage.cot.description: A blanket lies folded on the cot. Elspeth still waits for news of Wren’s return.
text.detail.elspeth_cottage.cot.lost: A blanket lies folded on the cot. Elspeth has heard the news, but Wren has not been brought back. The cot remains empty.
text.detail.elspeth_cottage.cot.rescued: A blanket lies folded on the cot. Wren is safely back with Elspeth at the Ferry Landing; he has not been brought to this cot.
text.detail.elspeth_cottage.cot.stays: A blanket lies folded on the cot. Wren has chosen to stay with Vesper in Fox Hollow. His message has reached Elspeth; the cot remains empty.
text.detail.elspeth_cottage.hearth.descriptio: A banked fire warms the stone hearth.
text.detail.empty_cottage.hearth.description: The hearth is cold and empty. No ashes remain.
text.detail.empty_cottage.sign.description: A weathered sign hangs from a nail beside the door.
text.detail.empty_cottage.sign.title: For-sale sign
text.detail.empty_nest.description: The abandoned nest holds only dry reeds.
text.detail.fen_outbound.description: The rope ferry runs along its cable. Leave two pennies for Mother Sedge before crossing to the isle; passage to recover your belongings is free.
text.detail.fen_return.description: The rope ferry returns to the Boathouse without a fare.
text.detail.fenwort_patch.description: A finite patch of fenwort grows under the willows. Pick one sprig at a time; a sprig dropped here can be gathered again.
text.detail.fenwort_patch.title: Fenwort Patch
text.detail.ferry.title: Rope ferry
text.detail.fox_prints.description: Small paw prints cross the soft mud, clear at the path's edge before the reeds swallow them.
text.detail.fox_prints.title: Fox prints
text.detail.glow.description: A pale glow waits just beyond the reeds. Douse any carried light, then seek the wisp.
text.detail.glow.title: Marsh glow
text.detail.gnawed_bones.description: Old bones are cracked and stripped clean.
text.detail.hollow.description: Flattened grass and old fox bones mark a place where something has rested.
text.detail.hollow.title: Hollow
text.detail.lost_whistle.description: A small handwritten notice asks about a missing whistle.
text.detail.lost_whistle.title: Lost tin whistle
text.detail.market_cross.description: The old stone cross stands where Ashmere gathers for news and trade. You can begin the epilogue here when your story is ready.
text.detail.marsh_reeds.description: Dense reeds rustle in the wind.
text.detail.marsh_shelter.description: The roots arch into a dry hollow above the black water. You may use it during this watch.
text.detail.masonry.description: Carefully fitted stones line the shaft. There is no opening in the masonry.
text.detail.mill_cellar.grain_bins.descriptio: The wooden bins hold a thin layer of old grain.
text.detail.mill_cellar.rat_holes.description: Tiny holes disappear into the masonry. Nothing stirs inside them.
text.detail.mill_loft.loose_board.description: The board creaks underfoot. Pale scratches run along its edge, but it reveals no passage.
text.detail.mill_loft.owl.description: The owl follows your movements with round, quiet eyes.
text.detail.notice.description: A weathered notice is nailed to the mooring post.
text.detail.notice.title: Landing notice
text.detail.old_mill.grain_sacks.description: The sacks smell of dry grain and the river.
text.detail.old_mill.ledger.description: A clothbound ledger lies beside the millstone.
text.detail.old_mill.ledger.title: Hob's ledger
text.detail.old_mill.millstone.description: A worn millstone rests over a scatter of flour.
text.detail.orchard.apple_trees.description: The low branches carry red apples; fallen fruit lies within reach.
text.detail.orchard.beehive.description: Bees pass through the hive’s narrow opening. It is best left alone.
text.detail.plank.description: The plank is worn but steady, with a dry line across the mire.
text.detail.plank.title: Plank
text.detail.road_sign.description: The flooded road sign is readable.
text.detail.road_sign.title: Flooded road sign
text.detail.rumor_board.description: Two notices are pinned to a wooden board beside the bar.
text.detail.rumor_board.title: Notice board
text.detail.smithy.anvil.description: Hammer marks cover the broad iron face.
text.detail.smithy.forge.description: The brick forge holds a bed of cooling coals.
text.detail.smithy.tools.description: Tongs, hammers and files hang in their places.
text.detail.tracks.description: The marks run along the bank and disappear into trampled reeds. The soft ground holds no clear story of who made them.
text.detail.tracks.title: Tracks
text.detail.ward_stone.description: A flat stone bears a weathered ring around a narrow doorway. Moss fills the shallow cuts at its edges.
text.detail.ward_stone.title: Ward stone
text.detail.well.description: A rope and bucket hang over clear, cold well water. You can fill your own waterskins here.
text.detail.well.title: The well
text.dialogue.a_vesper_meeting.meet_wren: “Wren, your mother is looking for you.”
text.dialogue.a_vesper_meeting.prompt: “You followed the tracks,” the stranger says. “I am Vesper. And this is Wren.” The boy looks up at his name.
text.dialogue.a_wick_offer.prompt: “Bring me three sprigs of fenwort and I will give you three bandages,” Wick says. “We can begin again immediately while the supplies last.”
text.dialogue.ada.leave_narration: You leave Ada to the evening.
text.dialogue.ada.prompt: Ada says, “The trees are west of the smithy. I only gather what has fallen.”
text.dialogue.aldric.offer.prompt: “You have searched the fen,” Aldric says. “Ring the chapel bell. Its sound may reach where our voices cannot.”
text.dialogue.aldric.prompt: Aldric looks up at the bell tower. “The stair is open. Take care on the steps.”
text.dialogue.aldric.ward: Aldric listens when you mention the ward of the fen.
text.dialogue.aldric_debt.on_time: Give Aldric Peg’s ledger before the deadline.
text.dialogue.aldric_debt.prompt: Aldric glances at the ledger. “Is this Peg’s account?”
text.dialogue.ash.prompt: The copying desks are open to anyone who wishes to learn.
text.dialogue.b_vesper_riddle.prompt: Vesper lays out letter tiles. “I carry a flame behind glass. Held in a hand, I guide a traveller through darkness. What am I?”
text.dialogue.b_wick_turn_in.prompt: Wick checks your three fenwort and his three bandages.
text.dialogue.c_vesper_answered.carry_message: “I’ll take your message to Elspeth. Wren can stay.”
text.dialogue.c_vesper_answered.prompt: “You have answered my riddle,” Vesper says. “Wren may stay here with me, if he wishes. Will you carry this message to his mother at the landing?”
text.dialogue.d9_aldric_fox.prompt: Aldric’s voice is cool. “You left the bell silent. The public nave remains open.”
text.dialogue.d9_aldric_prior.prompt: “The bell has sounded. Ashmere has heard our call,” Aldric says. “The public nave is open to you.”
text.dialogue.d9_elspeth_lost_prior.prompt: “The bell rang before anyone reached Wren. I still look for him when a boat comes in.”
text.dialogue.d9_elspeth_rescued_fox.prompt: “Wren is safely beside me. The bell stayed silent, but you brought him home.”
text.dialogue.d9_elspeth_rescued_prior.prompt: “Wren is safely beside me. I heard the bell, and now I can hear him laugh again.”
text.dialogue.d9_elspeth_stays_fox.prompt: “Wren is alive with Vesper. I have his message, and I will respect the place he chose.”
text.dialogue.d9_elspeth_stays_prior.prompt: “Wren is alive with Vesper. I have his message, though the bell rang before he came home.”
text.dialogue.d9_maud_lost_prior.prompt: “The bell rang before Wren was found. Elspeth has heard the news, and nobody here calls it a rescue.”
text.dialogue.d9_maud_rescued_fox.prompt: “Wren is home with Elspeth. The chapel bell stayed silent.”
text.dialogue.d9_maud_rescued_prior.prompt: “Wren is home with Elspeth, and the priory bell rang. That is the news at my bar.”
text.dialogue.d9_maud_stays_fox.prompt: “Wren is alive with Vesper by his own choice; Elspeth has his message. No bell rang.”
text.dialogue.d9_maud_stays_prior.prompt: “Wren is alive with Vesper; Elspeth has his message. The bell rang all the same.”
text.dialogue.d9_sedge_fox.prompt: Sedge gestures you in. “The bell is silent. Sit by the hearth; the swim and the herbs can wait until you are ready.”
text.dialogue.d9_sedge_prior.prompt: Sedge’s welcome is spare. “You rang the priory bell. I still teach the swim and the herbs.”
text.dialogue.d9_vesper_fox.prompt: Vesper smiles faintly. “You let the bell rest. The fox paths remain quiet.”
text.dialogue.d9_vesper_prior.prompt: Vesper looks toward the distant priory. “You rang Aldric’s bell. Its claim binds me still.”
text.dialogue.elspeth.accept: Will you look around the Green for a sign of Wren?
text.dialogue.elspeth.prompt: “My boy Wren hasn’t come home. I keep thinking the next boat might bring word of him.” She gathers herself. “You’re new to Ashmere, aren’t you?”
text.dialogue.elspeth_lost.prompt: Elspeth has heard the bell. She looks past you toward the river. “You haven't found him, have you?”
text.dialogue.elspeth_report.prompt: Elspeth watches the folded drawing in your hand.
text.dialogue.elspeth_report.report: I found this drawing on the Green.
text.dialogue.elspeth_rescue.prompt: Elspeth catches sight of Wren beside you. She reaches toward him. “Wren?”
text.dialogue.elspeth_rescued.prompt: Elspeth keeps Wren close beside her. “He’s home. I can hardly believe it.”
text.dialogue.elspeth_return.prompt: Elspeth looks at the folded message. “You have news of Wren?”
text.dialogue.elspeth_stays.prompt: Elspeth folds the message carefully. “I know where Wren is now. He has chosen to stay with Vesper.”
text.dialogue.gareth.leave_narration: You leave Gareth to the evening.
text.dialogue.gareth.prompt: Gareth says, “Ada minds the orchard while I’m at the anvil. Take fallen apples if you need them.”
text.dialogue.hale.prompt: The garden feeds the Priory. Even the thyme has its place.
text.dialogue.hob.prompt: Hob says, “The wheel is quiet tonight. Mind your footing on the loft boards.”
text.dialogue.maud_offer.prompt: “Clear the five rats out of my cellar and I’ll give you the key to the storage chest upstairs.”
text.dialogue.maud_turn_in.prompt: “Well? Have you dealt with those rats?”
text.dialogue.peg_debt.accept_late: Take the ledger; accept that only late delivery remains.
text.dialogue.peg_debt.accept_on_time: Take the ledger; promise to deliver it by the second day at six.
text.dialogue.peg_debt.elapsed: Ask about the ledger after the deadline.
text.dialogue.peg_debt.prompt: “Aldric at the Chapel Nave is still waiting for my ledger,” Peg says.
text.dialogue.vesper.prompt: The foxlike stranger watches you from beside the hollow.
text.dialogue.wisp.offer: The wisp offers a riddle and a ward for its answer. Will you accept?
text.dialogue.wisp.riddle: Keep any carried light doused. I come and go, yet never leave the shore. What am I?
text.dialogue.wren.prompt: The boy looks up from the reed in his hands.
text.dialogue.wren_escort.prompt: Wren glances from Vesper to you. “Mother must be worried. Will you walk back to her with me?”
text.dialogue.wren_escort.rescue: “Come with me. I’ll take you back to Elspeth.”
text.dialogue.wren_rejoin.prompt: Wren looks relieved to see you. “There you are. Can we go back together now?”
text.dialogue.wren_rejoin.rejoin: Rejoin Wren and continue to Elspeth.
text.dream.choice: The fox waits at a fork in the reeds.
text.dream.description: A dream waiting at the Lantern. Close it whenever you wish; its place will be kept.
text.dream.fen: You stand among the reeds of the fen. A narrow track winds toward a light you cannot quite see.
text.dream.follow.final: You follow the fox to the water’s edge. Across the fen, a lantern shines through the mist.
text.dream.fox: A red fox steps onto the track. It looks back once, waiting.
text.dream.opening: The Lantern falls quiet around you. Beyond the window, mist gathers over dark water.
text.dream.title: The Fen Dream
text.dream.wake.final: You turn toward the warmth of the Lantern. The fox slips between the reeds as the window brightens.
text.item.ale_cask.description: Maud keeps this finite cask behind her counter.
text.item.ale_cask.room: A small [ale cask](lantern_ale_cask) holds Maud’s ale.
text.item.apple.description: A small red apple, firm and sweet. Eating it restores up to six movement points.
text.item.apple_01.room: A ripe [apple](apple_01) lies in the grass.
text.item.apple_02.room: A ripe [apple](apple_02) lies in the grass.
text.item.apple_03.room: A ripe [apple](apple_03) lies in the grass.
text.item.bandage.description: A clean strip of linen from the infirmary.
text.item.bell_rites.description: A small bound volume titled [Bell Rites](bell_rites). Its single page is written in a steady hand.
text.item.bell_rites.room: [Bell Rites](bell_rites) rests on a copying desk.
text.item.brass_key.description: A small brass key with a narrow tooth.
text.item.brass_key.room: A small [brass key] lies here, its narrow tooth glinting.
text.item.cellar_key.description: An iron key, its bow worn smooth.
text.item.crow_corpse.description: The crow lies still, its dark feathers ruffled.
text.item.crow_nest.description: A broad tangle of twigs, large enough to hold a few small things, with a loose woven lid.
text.item.crow_nest.room: A [crow's nest](crow_nest) rests among the branches.
text.item.fenwort.description: A small sprig of fenwort, useful to Brother Wick.
text.item.fenwort.room: A [sprig of fenwort] grows low among the roots.
text.item.fox_drawing.description: A child's charcoal drawing shows a fox among tall reeds. The paper is creased and muddy. There is no name on it.
text.item.fox_drawing.room: A folded [fox drawing] lies near the elm's roots.
text.item.hound_corpse.description: The body of a fen hound.
text.item.hound_pelt.description: The coarse hide of a fen hound.
text.item.iron_sword.description: A balanced iron blade, sharper than Tobin’s old sword.
text.item.lamp_oil.description: A bottle of oil for refilling the torch. Its empty shell can still be sold.
text.item.lamp_oil.room: [A flask of lamp oil](lamp_oil) lies here.
text.item.old_coin.description: A worn coin, green with age.
text.item.rusty_sword.description: A sound old blade with rust along its edge.
text.item.satchel.description: A small satchel with room for four items.
text.item.silver_ring.description: A plain silver band, cold from the water.
text.item.spare_waterskin.description: A second sturdy leather waterskin, with a pale cord around its neck. It holds four quarter-litres.
text.item.storage_chest.description: A wooden chest with an iron lock.
text.item.sunken_chest.description: A heavy chest rests open, its corners dark with silt.
text.item.tin_whistle.description: A small tin whistle, dulled by dust.
text.item.tin_whistle.room: A small [tin whistle] lies in the trunk.
text.item.tithe_ledger.description: A narrow ledger lists the tithe owed to the Priory.
text.item.torch.description: An oil-soaked wick on a sturdy handle can be lit, doused and refilled with lamp oil.
text.item.trunk.description: An old wooden trunk. Its iron hasp is dark with age.
text.item.trunk.room: An old [trunk] sits under the slope of the roof.
text.item.vesper_message.description: A folded message addressed to Elspeth in a fine, slanting hand. Vesper entrusted it to you for Wren’s mother.
text.item.ward_of_the_fen.description: A small bound volume titled [The Ward of the Fen](ward_of_the_fen). Its single page is written in a steady hand.
text.item.ward_of_the_fen.room: [The Ward of the Fen](ward_of_the_fen) rests on a copying desk.
text.item.wooden_shield.description: A plain wooden shield, ready for your off hand.
text.item.wool_cloak.description: Heavy grey wool. Rain runs off it.
text.item.wool_cloak.room: A [wool cloak] hangs over the bedpost.
text.light.refueled: You refill the torch from the oil bottle.
text.liquid.poured: You pour into the other waterskin.
text.marsh.completed: You return to Reed Bank alive after the full marsh circuit. Sedge will hear of this watch.
text.marsh.failed: You left the watch route or fell. Return to Hound Run to begin another attempt.
text.marsh.journal.active: Follow the marked marsh circuit after accepting the watch.
text.marsh.journal.completed: You completed the five-entry marsh circuit alive.
text.marsh.journal.failed: This attempt ended. Return to Hound Run to begin another watch now.
text.marsh.restart: You begin a fresh marsh watch. The earlier route no longer counts.
text.marsh.sedge.acknowledged: Sedge thanks you for making the marsh circuit and returning alive.
text.marsh.sedge.action: Tell Sedge of the marsh watch
text.marsh.sedge.prompt: Sedge sees the marsh upon you and listens to your account of the circuit.
text.marsh.shelter: You pause beneath the drowned oak’s roots. The shelter is dry; your wounds and the hour remain as they were.
text.marsh.start: You begin a marsh watch from Hound Run. Follow the reed bank, willow shade, drowned oak, and the return path.
text.narration.a_vesper_meeting: Wren nods. “I know. Vesper was showing me the fox paths.” You have found him alive, here in the hollow.
text.narration.aldric.accept: Aldric nods toward the tower stair. “Up through the belfry. The rope is beside the bell.”
text.narration.aldric.bell: “It has called this village together longer than I have lived here,” Aldric says.
text.narration.aldric.leave: Aldric returns to his watch beneath the tower.
text.narration.aldric.ward: Aldric calls it an old marsh tradition: a promise to respect the fen, not a spell.
text.narration.aldric_debt.late: Aldric takes the overdue ledger without payment.
text.narration.aldric_debt.on_time: Aldric takes the ledger and pays you ten pennies from his purse.
text.narration.b_vesper_riddle: “A lantern. Well answered,” Vesper says. Wren smiles. The question of returning to Elspeth still waits.
text.narration.bandaged: You bind the wound with a clean bandage. The bleeding stops.
text.narration.begin_epilogue: You pause beside the market cross and let the village settle around you.
text.narration.bleed.applied: The hound tears your skin. The wound begins to bleed.
text.narration.bleed.refreshed: The hound opens the wound again.
text.narration.c_vesper_answered: Vesper places his folded message in your hand. Wren stays beside him. You agree to take the message to Elspeth at Ferry Landing.
text.narration.crow_acquired: The crow picks up the old coin.
text.narration.crow_delivered: The crow leaves the old coin in its nest.
text.narration.crow_fallback: The crow drops the old coin here.
text.narration.crow_shoo: The crow drops the old coin and flies off.
text.narration.eat_apple: You eat the apple and feel a little less weary.
text.narration.elspeth.accept: You agree to look around Village Green for a sign of Wren.
text.narration.elspeth.directions: “North from here, up Well Lane,” Elspeth says. “Keep going north and you’ll reach Village Green. That’s the heart of Ashmere.”
text.narration.elspeth.inn: “Go north to Well Lane, then east into the Drowned Lantern. Maud keeps the inn. Speak to her at the bar; she’ll tell you what needs doing.”
text.narration.elspeth.report: “That could be Wren's drawing,” Elspeth says. “He was always exploring. The reeds south of the landing may be worth searching, but I can't know where he went.” “Look closely at the tracks on Reed Bank,” Elspeth says. “Follow them south. Wren is still missing.”
text.narration.elspeth.wren: “My son.” Elspeth looks back at the river. “He’s always off exploring, but he should have been home by now.”
text.narration.elspeth_lost: You tell her the bell was rung before Wren was found. Elspeth lowers her eyes. “Then I'll keep watching the landing.”
text.narration.elspeth_rescue: Wren runs into Elspeth’s arms. She holds him close. “You brought him home. Thank you.” Wren stays with his mother at the landing.
text.narration.elspeth_rescued: Elspeth rests a hand on Wren’s shoulder. “We won’t forget what you did.”
text.narration.elspeth_return: Elspeth accepts Vesper’s message and reads it slowly. “He has chosen to stay,” she says. “Thank you for bringing me his word.” Wren remains with Vesper at Fox Hollow.
text.narration.elspeth_stays: “I will keep his message,” Elspeth says. She tucks the folded paper safely inside her shawl.
text.narration.gather_carefully: You carefully gather two sprigs of fenwort.
text.narration.harvest: You gather a sprig of fenwort.
text.narration.maud.accept: You agree to clear Maud’s cellar.
text.narration.maud.done: Maud sets an iron key in your palm. “For the storage chest upstairs. You’ve earned it.”
text.narration.peg_debt.accept_late: Peg puts her ledger in your hands. “It is late already, but Aldric still needs it.”
text.narration.peg_debt.accept_on_time: Peg puts her ledger in your hands and names the second day at six as the deadline.
text.narration.peg_debt.elapsed: “The time for that ledger passed,” Peg says. She asks nothing of you.
text.narration.ring_bell: You pull the rope. The bell answers with a deep note that rolls over Ashmere and the priory.
text.narration.seek_wisp: You follow the glow and find a wisp waiting above the reeds.
text.narration.seek_wisp_failed: The glow slips from your sight. You can seek it again.
text.narration.silence_bell: You leave the bell rope untouched. In the hush, the fox has your answer.
text.narration.study_tracks: You kneel beside the tracks. Small footprints run south across the mire toward Fox Hollow. They give you a lead, but Wren remains unfound.
text.narration.vesper: “The firm path runs north,” the stranger says. “There is no need to wait for the tide.”
text.narration.vesper_wrong: Vesper shakes his head gently. “Try the letters again. Think of the light a traveller carries.”
text.narration.wick.accept: You agree to exchange three fenwort for three bandages with Wick.
text.narration.wick.exchange: Wick takes the three fenwort and places three bandages in your hand.
text.narration.wisp.accept: The wisp waits for your answer.
text.narration.wisp.correct: The wisp brightens. You learn the ward of the fen.
text.narration.wisp.wrong: The wisp dims. That is not the answer.
text.narration.wren: “I never knew the fen had so many fox paths,” Wren says, turning the reed between his fingers.
text.narration.wren_escort: Wren joins you for the walk to Ferry Landing. Vesper keeps his folded message and watches you set out together.
text.narration.wren_rejoin: Wren steps beside you again, ready to continue to his mother at Ferry Landing.
text.npc.ada.description: Ada wears a work apron and smells faintly of apple leaves.
text.npc.aldric.description: Aldric wears a plain dark habit. His hands are ink-stained, and his gaze moves to the tower whenever the wind shifts.
text.npc.aldric.room: [Prior Aldric] stands beside the altar, watching the open stair to the tower.
text.npc.ash.description: Novice Ash keeps ink on his fingertips and a half-finished thought on his tongue.
text.npc.ash.room: [Novice Ash](ash) studies a scrap of writing.
text.npc.cellar_rat.description: A small grey rat watches from beside a barrel, its whiskers twitching.
text.npc.cellar_rat_1.room: A [[cellar_rat_1|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
text.npc.cellar_rat_2.room: A [[cellar_rat_2|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
text.npc.cellar_rat_3.room: A [[cellar_rat_3|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
text.npc.cellar_rat_4.room: A [[cellar_rat_4|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
text.npc.cellar_rat_5.room: A [[cellar_rat_5|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
text.npc.crow.carrying: The crow grips an old coin in its beak.
text.npc.crow.description: A black crow picks its way along the ground, quick to notice anything left behind.
text.npc.crow_branches.room: A [crow](crow_branches) watches the ground with bright eyes.
text.npc.crow_green.room: A [crow](crow_green) watches the ground with bright eyes.
text.npc.crow_oak.room: A [crow](crow_oak) watches the ground with bright eyes.
text.npc.elspeth.description: A woman in a worn shawl keeps turning toward the river. One hand worries the edge of her sleeve; her eyes search every face on the landing.
text.npc.elspeth.room: [Elspeth] stands beside the mooring post, watching each boat come in.
text.npc.fen_hound.description: A lean hound with a coarse marsh coat.
text.npc.gareth.description: Gareth’s hands carry the soot and scars of long work at the forge.
text.npc.hale.description: Novice Hale has soil on his cuffs and a patient, careful manner.
text.npc.hale.room: [Novice Hale](hale) pauses beside the stone walk.
text.npc.hob.description: The miller has flour in the seams of his coat and a patient, watchful manner.
text.npc.maud.description: Broad, floury, sharp-eyed. She has been widowed by the river and has not forgiven it.
text.npc.maud.room: [Widow Maud] is here behind the bar, wiping a mug that is already clean.
text.npc.oak_deer.description: A wary deer, poised to flee.
text.npc.orchard_deer.description: A wary deer, poised to flee.
text.npc.peg.description: Peg keeps careful accounts and speaks without wasting a word.
text.npc.sedge.description: Mother Sedge has lived beside the fen longer than anyone remembers. She teaches swimming freely to those who ask.
text.npc.sedge.room: [Mother Sedge] sorts dried leaves beside the hearth.
text.npc.tobin.description: Tobin keeps an old sword beside him. He offers immediate lessons in swords and dodge for two pennies each. Learning a skill and qualifying to use it are separate.
text.npc.tobin.room: [Tobin] stands beside the north gate, watching the road.
text.npc.vesper.description: A slender figure in a russet coat stands beneath the roots. His pointed face and bright amber eyes are unmistakably foxlike.
text.npc.vesper.room: [Vesper] waits beside the hollow, a russet tail curled around his feet.
text.npc.wick.description: Wick welcomes visitors at any hour. He will exchange three fenwort for three bandages when you hold the herbs and he has the linen. These exchanges are optional; his supplies are finite.
text.npc.wick.room: [Brother Wick] sorts linen beside the infirmary table.
text.npc.willow_deer.description: A wary deer, poised to flee.
text.npc.wisp.description: A patient pale light hovers in the still air. It shies away from a carried flame; douse your light to speak or answer.
text.npc.wren.description: A small boy with muddy knees holds a reed between his fingers. His eyes are bright with curiosity.
text.npc.wren.room: [Wren], a small boy with muddy knees, looks about him.
text.peg.haggle.learned: You pay 2 pennies and learn haggle.
text.peg.haggle.prompt: For 2 pennies I can teach you haggle. You may learn now; using it requires DEX 10 and MV 5. With usable haggle, Buy prices are rounded down to nine tenths, with a minimum of 1 penny; Sell prices stay the same.
text.quest.a_night_in_the_marsh.title: Night in the Marsh
text.quest.bell.abandoned: You left the bell quest unfinished.
text.quest.bell.active: Climb from Chapel Nave through Bell Tower to the Belfry and ring the bell.
text.quest.bell.failed: The bell quest ended without a ringing.
text.quest.bell.fox: You left the bell silent. The fox has your allegiance.
text.quest.bell.prior: You rang the chapel bell. Its first call belongs to Aldric and the priory.
text.quest.bell.ready: The bell has sounded across Ashmere.
text.quest.bell.resolved: You rang the chapel bell for Aldric.
text.quest.bell.title: The Bell of Ashmere
text.quest.chandlers_debt.active: Carry Peg’s ledger directly to Aldric at the Chapel Nave before the third day at six. Payment is due only by the second day at six.
text.quest.chandlers_debt.late: You delivered the ledger late, without payment.
text.quest.chandlers_debt.on_time: You delivered the ledger on time and received ten pennies.
text.quest.chandlers_debt.ready: Bring the ledger directly to Aldric at the Chapel Nave.
text.quest.chandlers_debt.resolved: You delivered Peg’s ledger to Aldric.
text.quest.chandlers_debt.title: Chandler’s Debt
text.quest.first_lead.abandoned: You set aside the search for a sign of Wren.
text.quest.first_lead.active: Look for a sign of Wren on Village Green.
text.quest.first_lead.failed: You could not follow the first lead.
text.quest.first_lead.ready: You found a fox drawing. Bring it to Elspeth at Ferry Landing.
text.quest.first_lead.resolved: Elspeth thought the drawing might be Wren's and suggested searching the reeds south of the landing.
text.quest.first_lead.title: The First Lead
text.quest.infirmary_herbs.abandoned: You left the optional herb exchange.
text.quest.infirmary_herbs.active: Retrieve three fenwort into your hands and return to Wick. Ground, stored or corpse-held herbs need to be recovered first.
text.quest.infirmary_herbs.ready: Wick can exchange your three directly held fenwort for three funded bandages.
text.quest.infirmary_herbs.resolved: The exchange is complete. You may explicitly accept another while you hold three fenwort and Wick has three bandages; it is optional.
text.quest.infirmary_herbs.title: Infirmary Herbs
text.quest.lantern.active: You have rested at the Lantern. A dream waits at the Inn Rooms bed; return there to resume it.
text.quest.lantern.resolved: You rested at the Lantern and acknowledged the fen dream.
text.quest.lantern.title: A Room at the Lantern
text.quest.mauds_cellar.active: Clear the five rats from the Lantern cellar.
text.quest.mauds_cellar.ready: The five cellar rats are dead. Return to Maud at the Drowned Lantern.
text.quest.mauds_cellar.resolved: You cleared Maud’s cellar and received the storage key.
text.quest.mauds_cellar.title: Maud’s Cellar
text.quest.missing_child.abandoned: You left the search for Wren.
text.quest.missing_child.active: Elspeth asks you to search for Wren. Study the tracks at Reed Bank, south of the landing.
text.quest.missing_child.answered: Vesper accepted your answer. Speak to Wren about going home, or to Vesper about carrying a message to Elspeth while Wren stays.
text.quest.missing_child.deliver: Wren has chosen to stay with Vesper. Deliver Vesper’s original message to Elspeth at Ferry Landing; if you left it behind, recover it first.
text.quest.missing_child.failed: The search for Wren has failed.
text.quest.missing_child.following: Wren is walking with you. Take him to Elspeth at Ferry Landing and speak to her to complete the return.
text.quest.missing_child.lead: The tracks lead south across Mire Crossing toward Fox Hollow. Wren remains unfound.
text.quest.missing_child.lost: The bell rang before you met Wren. The search has ended without bringing him home; Elspeth has not received a message or a rescue.
text.quest.missing_child.met: You met Wren alive at Fox Hollow. Speak to Vesper and answer his letter-bank riddle. Wren has not returned home.
text.quest.missing_child.rescued: You brought Wren safely to his mother, Elspeth, at Ferry Landing. He remains with her.
text.quest.missing_child.resolved: The search for Wren has ended.
text.quest.missing_child.separated: You were separated from Wren. Return to where you left him and speak to him to Rejoin before continuing to Elspeth.
text.quest.missing_child.stays: Wren chose to remain with Vesper at Fox Hollow. You delivered Vesper’s message to his mother, Elspeth.
text.quest.missing_child.title: The Missing Child
text.quest.watch_rounds.title: Watchman’s Rounds
text.quest.wisp_ward.active: Answer the wisp’s riddle. You may ask again immediately.
text.quest.wisp_ward.resolved: You answered the wisp and learned the ward of the fen.
text.quest.wisp_ward.title: The Wisp’s Ward
text.readable.bell: Letters worn by years circle the rim: ASHMERE. The bell carries across Ashmere and the public priory rooms.
text.readable.bell_rites: The Priory bell calls witness to a vow. A clear note carries the rite beyond the stone walls; the keeper tends both rope and promise.
text.readable.cellar_help: Maud needs help clearing rats from the cellar. Speak to her at the bar.
text.readable.duty_roster: Tobin leads one short round at a time. Join him at each checkpoint. If you leave, return and Rejoin. If you die, return and Restart immediately.
text.readable.empty_cottage.sign: This cottage is for sale. Enquiries may be left with the miller. No terms have been agreed.
text.readable.fox_prints: The prints are small and close-set. They turn into the reeds; following them by sight ends at the first pool of dark water.
text.readable.hollow: Flattened grass and old fox bones mark a place where something has rested.
text.readable.lost_whistle: Lost a tin whistle? Ask at the Drowned Lantern.
text.readable.notice: Keep the landing clear. Tie boats to the mooring post.
text.readable.old_mill.ledger: Grain received, flour delivered. Hob has balanced every line; a note in the margin reads: Mind the loose board upstairs.
text.readable.plank: The plank is worn but steady, with a dry line across the mire.
text.readable.road_sign: The King’s Road is flooded beyond this gate and lies outside this chapter. Return west to Village Green.
text.readable.tracks: Several narrow marks cross the bank toward the water. Wet reeds hide where they continue.
text.readable.ward_of_the_fen: The ward is a promise kept between the Priory and the fen. Ask Aldric how its protection is renewed.
text.readable.ward_stone: A worn ring surrounds a carved doorway. Beneath it, the remaining marks read: “Keep the threshold. Let the path remain open.”
text.room.adder_nest.description: A dry mound rises above the water. An [empty nest](empty_nest) lies among the reeds.
text.room.adder_nest.title: Adder Nest
text.room.belfry.description: Wind passes through the slats and over the [bell](bell), dark with age. Its rope hangs within reach. The stair leads down to the chapel.
text.room.belfry.title: Belfry
text.room.bell_tower.description: A narrow stair climbs inside the chapel tower. Old mortar flakes from the wall. Above, daylight falls through the belfry slats; below, the nave waits in silence.
text.room.bell_tower.title: Bell Tower
text.room.black_pool.description: Still black water lies beside a broad, dry bank. Firm footing runs north to the oak, east toward Fox Hollow and south to a shallow reed edge. The water has no safe way down.
text.room.black_pool.title: Black Pool
text.room.boathouse.description: Weathered timbers shelter an unattended [rope ferry](ferry). A taut cable crosses the fen to the isle.
text.room.boathouse.title: Boathouse
text.room.chandler.description: Peg keeps the chandler’s shelves in order. The well lane lies east; steps lead down to the storeroom.
text.room.chandler.title: Chandler
text.room.chandler_storeroom.description: Crates and empty casks line the storeroom. The chandler is upstairs.
text.room.chandler_storeroom.title: Chandler Storeroom
text.room.chapel_nave.description: The nave is cold and high. A fresco covers the east wall, and the altar is plain stone.
text.room.chapel_nave.title: Chapel Nave
text.room.chapel_steps.description: Wide stone steps, worn into dips, climb to the chapel door. An alms bowl sits on the top step.
text.room.chapel_steps.title: Chapel Steps
text.room.cloister.description: Open stone arches surround a quiet courtyard. The nave is south, the public infirmary east.
text.room.cloister.title: Cloister
text.room.cottage_loft.description: [Bare rafters](rafters) frame the small loft. Dust lies undisturbed beneath the sloping roof; the stair descends to the empty room below.
text.room.cottage_loft.title: Cottage Loft
text.room.drowned_lantern.description: The inn is low and warm and smells of peat smoke and spilled ale. The hearth is big enough to stand in. The [rumor board](rumor_board) is thick with pinned notes, and Maud’s bar runs along the back wall.
text.room.drowned_lantern.title: The Drowned Lantern
text.room.drowned_oak.description: A broad oak stands in dark water, its lower trunk silvered by old flood marks. The ground is still firm beneath its roots, and the willow path leads north. A firm bank leads east to the mire crossing. Broad branches offer a way up; a dry bank follows the water south to the black pool. A [shelter](marsh_shelter) opens under the roots.
text.room.drowned_oak.title: Drowned Oak
text.room.east_gate.description: A [road sign](road_sign) stands by a flooded lane. The village green is west of you.
text.room.east_gate.title: East Gate
text.room.elspeth_cottage.description: The small cottage is quiet. A [cot](cot) stands near the [hearth](hearth). No homecoming has been reported.
text.room.elspeth_cottage.lost: The quiet cottage holds a [cot](cot) beside the [hearth](hearth). Elspeth has heard the news, but Wren has not been brought back. The cot remains empty.
text.room.elspeth_cottage.rescued: The quiet cottage holds a [cot](cot) beside the [hearth](hearth). Wren is safely back with Elspeth at the Ferry Landing; he has not been brought to this cot.
text.room.elspeth_cottage.stays: The quiet cottage holds a [cot](cot) beside the [hearth](hearth). Wren has chosen to stay with Vesper in Fox Hollow. His message has reached Elspeth; the cot remains empty.
text.room.elspeth_cottage.title: Elspeth’s Cottage
text.room.empty_cottage.description: A [for-sale sign](sign) hangs by the door. The [cold hearth](hearth) is swept clean, and a narrow stair climbs to the loft. The mill stands to the north.
text.room.empty_cottage.title: Empty Cottage
text.room.fen_isle_landing.description: Reeds brush the [rope ferry](ferry). A narrow path leads east to a hut; south, a shrine stands among the sedge.
text.room.fen_isle_landing.title: Fen Isle Landing
text.room.ferry_landing.description: Reeds crowd a slick wooden landing, and the river slides past it the color of strong tea. A mooring post leans into the current with a [notice](notice) nailed to it. Tide marks stripe the pilings.
text.room.ferry_landing.title: Ferry Landing
text.room.fishing_shallows.description: Reeds stand in shallow water beside a strip of dry, firm ground. Small ripples move between the stems. The bank leads north to the black pool.
text.room.fishing_shallows.title: Fishing Shallows
text.room.fox_den_deep.description: A shallow chamber opens beneath the roots. Its broad entrance admits daylight and the open night sky; the dry floor and low walls remain visible without a lamp. A worn [ward stone](ward_stone) rests beside the passage up to Fox Hollow.
text.room.fox_den_deep.title: Fox Den Deep
text.room.fox_hollow.description: The path ends at a sheltered [hollow](hollow) among the reeds. Wren sits beside a foxlike stranger beneath the roots. The firm path returns north across the mire. A dry path leads west to the black pool. Beneath the roots, a shallow passage slopes down into the den.
text.room.fox_hollow.title: Fox Hollow
text.room.gate_tower.description: Wind passes through the low tower. The stairs lead straight down to the Watch Post.
text.room.gate_tower.title: Gate Tower
text.room.herb_garden.description: Herbs fill crooked beds between the reeds. The hut door lies west.
text.room.herb_garden.title: Herb Garden
text.room.hound_run.description: A trampled path crosses the sedge. [Gnawed bones](gnawed_bones) lie beside the reeds.
text.room.hound_run.title: Hound Run
text.room.hut_loft.dark: The loft is dark. You know the ladder leads down.
text.room.hut_loft.description: The low loft smells of dried leaves and old rope. The ladder is the only way down.
text.room.hut_loft.title: Hut Loft
text.room.infirmary.description: Clean linen hangs above a long table. The cloister lies west.
text.room.infirmary.title: Infirmary
text.room.inn_attic.description: Dust lies thick as felt. A trunk with an iron hasp sits under the slope of the roof.
text.room.inn_attic.title: Inn Attic
text.room.inn_rooms.description: A narrow passage of doors under the eaves. One stands open on a bed made up tight, and a window over the green. The ceiling sags a little at the end of the passage. A plain [bed](bed) stands ready.
text.room.inn_rooms.title: Inn Rooms
text.room.isle_hut.description: Bundles of drying herbs hang from the rafters. An open door leads to the garden, and a ladder rises into the loft.
text.room.isle_hut.title: Isle Hut
text.room.isle_shrine.description: A worn stone marks a quiet sanctuary beside the fen. No priest tends it. The path north returns to the landing.
text.room.isle_shrine.title: Isle Shrine
text.room.kitchen_garden.description: Rows of kitchen herbs grow between gravel paths. Bees move through the thyme.
text.room.kitchen_garden.title: Kitchen Garden
text.room.lantern_cellar.description: Ale casks lie on their sides in cradles. The floor is gritty, and the air tastes of old beer. Rat holes gnaw the base of every wall.
text.room.lantern_cellar.title: Lantern Cellar
text.room.marsh_light.dark: Dark reeds hide the marsh. A [glow](glow) hovers above the path.
text.room.marsh_light.description: Firm footing threads the reeds. A [glow](glow) hovers ahead, beyond the [reeds](reeds).
text.room.marsh_light.title: Marsh Light
text.room.mill_cellar.dark: Darkness fills the cellar. The stair leads up.
text.room.mill_cellar.description: [Grain bins](grain_bins) crowd the stone cellar. Small [rat holes](rat_holes) open beneath them; the stair returns to the mill above.
text.room.mill_cellar.title: Mill Cellar
text.room.mill_loft.dark: Darkness fills the loft. The stair leads down.
text.room.mill_loft.description: An [owl](owl) watches from the rafters. One [loose board](loose_board) stands proud of the dusty floor; the stair descends to the mill.
text.room.mill_loft.title: Mill Loft
text.room.mire_crossing.description: A narrow [plank](plank) spans the deepest mud. Firm banks lead north to the reeds and west beneath the old oak; the path continues south.
text.room.mire_crossing.flooded: Water darkens the mud around the [plank](plank), but the firm banks remain passable north and west. The paths south and east remain open.
text.room.mire_crossing.title: Mire Crossing
text.room.north_gate.description: The north gate is oak banded with iron, set in the village wall. North, a track climbs to the priory.
text.room.north_gate.title: North Gate
text.room.oak_branches.description: Broad oak limbs make a firm perch above the fen. The trunk leads down to the roots, and a stout branch rises into the crown.
text.room.oak_branches.title: Oak Branches
text.room.oak_crown.description: Leaves stir around the oak’s open crown. Branches and pale sky fill the gaps; the sturdy limb below leads back down.
text.room.oak_crown.title: Oak Crown
text.room.old_causeway.description: Dry stones cross the marsh. A [carved fox](carved_fox) watches the path.
text.room.old_causeway.title: Old Causeway
text.room.old_mill.description: The still [millstone](millstone) fills the floor. [Grain sacks](grain_sacks) lean against its base, and [Hob's ledger](ledger) lies open beside it. Stairs lead up to the loft and down to the cellar; the southern door opens toward an empty cottage.
text.room.old_mill.title: Old Mill
text.room.orchard.description: Low apple trees shelter a grassy enclosure west of the smithy. Ripe fruit rests beneath the [apple trees](apple_trees); a [beehive](beehive) hums at the edge.
text.room.orchard.title: The Orchard
text.room.pool_bottom.dark: Dark water presses around you. You know the bank lies above.
text.room.pool_bottom.description: A sunken chest rests on the bottom. The bank lies above.
text.room.pool_bottom.title: Pool Bottom
text.room.prior_study.description: Shelves flank a plain desk. A ledger of household accounts lies closed beside an inkpot.
text.room.prior_study.title: Prior Study
text.room.reed_bank.description: The path reaches a low bank above brown fen water. [Tracks](tracks) mark the damp earth near the reeds. Firmer ground bends west under the willows. A firm path leads south to the mire crossing.
text.room.reed_bank.title: Reed Bank
text.room.reed_path.description: A narrow path presses south between tall reeds. Mud darkens the edges, where [fox prints](fox_prints) cross the path and vanish among the stems. The landing lies north.
text.room.reed_path.flooded: Water laps at the reeds beside the [fox prints](fox_prints). The firm path still runs north to the landing and south to Reed Bank.
text.room.reed_path.title: Reed Path
text.room.scriptorium.description: Daylight falls across two books: [The Ward of the Fen](ward_of_the_fen) and [Bell Rites](bell_rites). Narrow desks stand ready for copying.
text.room.scriptorium.title: Scriptorium
text.room.smithy.description: The forge has gone quiet for the evening. A broad [anvil](anvil) stands beside the [forge](forge), with [tools](tools) arranged along the wall.
text.room.smithy.title: Gareth’s Smithy
text.room.spire.description: Wind moves around the stone crown. Ashmere roofs and the broad fen stretch below.
text.room.spire.title: Priory Spire
text.room.tide_flats.description: The public path ends at the edge of the tide flats. Dry stones lead back west.
text.room.tide_flats.title: Tide Flats
text.room.village_green.description: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass at the heart of Ashmere. The stocks stand empty beside the weathered [market cross](market_cross). Elspeth is still waiting for Wren’s return.
text.room.village_green.lost: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass at the heart of Ashmere. The stocks stand empty beside the weathered [market cross](market_cross). Nobody has brought Wren back. Elspeth has heard the news, and the road to the landing remains open.
text.room.village_green.lost_prior: An old elm shades the [market cross](market_cross). The bell rang before Wren was found. Elspeth knows he was lost; the road to the landing remains open.
text.room.village_green.rescued: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass at the heart of Ashmere. The stocks stand empty beside the weathered [market cross](market_cross). Wren is safely back with his mother at the landing.
text.room.village_green.rescued_fox: An old elm shades the [market cross](market_cross). Wren is safely home with Elspeth; the bell stayed silent.
text.room.village_green.rescued_prior: An old elm shades the [market cross](market_cross). Wren is safely home with Elspeth, and villagers speak of the bell that rang for him.
text.room.village_green.stays: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass at the heart of Ashmere. The stocks stand empty beside the weathered [market cross](market_cross). Wren has chosen to stay with Vesper; his message has reached his mother.
text.room.village_green.stays_fox: An old elm shades the [market cross](market_cross). Wren is alive with Vesper by choice; Elspeth has his message, and the bell stayed silent.
text.room.village_green.stays_prior: An old elm shades the [market cross](market_cross). Wren is alive with Vesper by choice, Elspeth has his message, and the bell has rung.
text.room.village_green.title: Village Green
text.room.watch_cell.description: The empty cell stands open. You can walk back into the Watch Post without a key.
text.room.watch_cell.title: Watch Cell
text.room.watch_post.description: An open guard room overlooks the northern arch. The [duty roster](duty_roster) hangs beside an unlocked cell and the tower stairs.
text.room.watch_post.title: Watch Post
text.room.well_bottom.dark: The water is black. You know the shaft leads up.
text.room.well_bottom.description: The drowned stones bear [carved initials](initials). An old coin rests in the silt. The shaft leads up.
text.room.well_bottom.title: Well Bottom
text.room.well_lane.description: A cobbled lane climbs from the landing toward the green. In the middle stands the well, with a bucket on a chain. The Drowned Lantern’s sign creaks to the east. The [well](well) has a rope and bucket for drawing clear water.
text.room.well_lane.title: Well Lane
text.room.well_shaft.dark: Darkness fills the shaft. The stair up leads back to Well Lane.
text.room.well_shaft.description: A narrow stair descends beside old [masonry](masonry). The way up returns to Well Lane.
text.room.well_shaft.title: Well Shaft
text.room.willow_shade.description: Long willow branches hang over a strip of firm ground. The reed bank is east; south, the path passes beneath a great old oak. A [fenwort patch](fenwort_patch) grows beneath the roots.
text.room.willow_shade.title: Willow Shade
text.scene.bell_rung.bell: The bell's voice shudders through the timber around you.
text.scene.bell_rung.fen: Beyond the slats, the fen lies still beyond the bell’s reach.
text.scene.bell_rung.fox: When the last note fades, even the fox calls have gone quiet.
text.scene.bell_silenced.aldric: Aldric sees the untouched rope. His face goes cold. “Then you have made your choice,” he says.
text.scene.bell_silenced.bell: The bell hangs still above Ashmere. Far below, the fen keeps its own counsel.
text.scene.epilogue_lost_prior.1: Wren did not return. His absence sits with the village even here.
text.scene.epilogue_lost_prior.2: The bell you rang still seems to echo from the priory hill. The fox calls have quieted.
text.scene.epilogue_lost_prior.3: You leave the cross carrying the truth of Wren’s loss.
text.scene.epilogue_rescued_fox.1: Wren is home with Elspeth. Their voices carry across the green.
text.scene.epilogue_rescued_fox.2: The bell remains silent. The fen and its fox calls answer for themselves.
text.scene.epilogue_rescued_fox.3: You leave the cross knowing Wren came safely through.
text.scene.epilogue_rescued_prior.1: Wren is home with Elspeth. Their voices carry across the green.
text.scene.epilogue_rescued_prior.2: The bell you rang still seems to echo from the priory hill. The fox calls have quieted.
text.scene.epilogue_rescued_prior.3: You leave the cross knowing Wren came safely through.
text.scene.epilogue_stays_fox.1: Wren remains with Vesper in the fen; his message has reached Elspeth.
text.scene.epilogue_stays_fox.2: The bell remains silent. The fen and its fox calls answer for themselves.
text.scene.epilogue_stays_fox.3: You leave the cross knowing Wren chose his own place.
text.scene.epilogue_stays_prior.1: Wren remains with Vesper in the fen; his message has reached Elspeth.
text.scene.epilogue_stays_prior.2: The bell you rang still seems to echo from the priory hill. The fox calls have quieted.
text.scene.epilogue_stays_prior.3: You leave the cross knowing Wren chose his own place.
text.sedge.herbalism.learned: You pay 2 pennies and learn herbalism.
text.sedge.herbalism.prompt: For 2 pennies I can teach you herbalism. You may learn now; using it requires INT 10 and MV 5. With usable herbalism, careful gathering takes two existing sprigs of fenwort together.
text.sedge.swim.learned: Mother Sedge teaches you to keep afloat and swim. You have learned swim.
text.sedge.swim.prompt: Mother Sedge offers to teach you to swim.
text.service.ale.used: Maud takes a penny and pours a serving of ale. You drink it and recover movement.
text.service.already_paid: You have already paid for the bed.
text.service.meal.used: Maud takes two pennies and serves bread. You eat the meal and recover movement.
text.service.room.used: Maud takes your three pennies. The bed upstairs in Inn Rooms is yours to rest in.
text.service.unaffordable: The exact penny payment is unavailable.
text.shop.bought: Peg takes your pennies and hands you the purchase.
text.shop.sold: Peg takes the item and counts your pennies into your hand.
text.skill.bandage.label: Bandage
text.skill.dodge.label: Dodge
text.skill.haggle.label: Haggle
text.skill.haggle.requirement: DEX 10 and MV 5 required to use.
text.skill.herbalism.label: Herbalism
text.skill.herbalism.requirement: INT 10 and MV 5 required to use.
text.skill.swim.label: Swim
text.skill.swim.requirement: No attribute requirement for learning. Learned swim is required for underwater descent.
text.skill.swords.label: Swords
text.tobin.dodge.learned: Tobin accepts two pennies and teaches you dodge.
text.tobin.dodge.prompt: “I can teach you dodge now. The lesson costs two pennies. Dodge requires DEX at least 10 to use.”
text.tobin.swords.learned: Tobin accepts two pennies and teaches you swords. He gives you his rusty sword.
text.tobin.swords.prompt: “I can teach you swords now. The lesson costs two pennies. I will give you this rusty sword. Swords require STR at least 10 to use.”
text.transport.outbound.used: You draw the rope ferry across the fen and step onto Fen Isle Landing.
text.transport.return.used: You draw the rope ferry back to the Boathouse.
text.transport.unaffordable: You need two pennies for passage to the isle.
text.watch.active: Follow Tobin by ordinary exits. A departure pauses the attempt; return and Rejoin. After a fatal fall, return and Restart immediately.
text.watch.completed: You completed the rounds with Tobin. The watch recognizes your help.
text.watch.departed: Tobin takes the next leg alone. Walk the ordinary exit to join him.
text.watch.prompt: Tobin checks where the two of you stand in the rounds.
text.watch.rejoined: Tobin waits beside you again. The next leg continues from here.
text.watch.restarted: Tobin begins a fresh attempt from here. Earlier checkpoint credit is cleared.
text.watch.started: Tobin welcomes you on the rounds. No checkpoint is earned until you walk after him.
text.water.drowned: Your breath fails. Your belongings remain in your corpse below; you return to the Chapel.
text.water.warning: You must know how to swim and carry at most 6000g. Diving costs 10 MV. Surface within 120 real seconds or drown.
text.wick.bandage.learned: Wick shows you how to bind a wound. You learn bandaging.
text.wick.bandage.prompt: Wick offers to teach you how to bind a bleeding wound. The lesson is free.
